The '''''Starbolt''-class Assault Carrier''' was introduced to the market in the years prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was marketed to mercenary and planetary defense force units during the war and was offered with a package deal complete with a compliment of [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] produced starfighters and speeders outsourced from other manufacturers, typically a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] and [[Invader AA-9 Assault Airspeeder]]s, [[Rush Troop Transport Speeder]]s, and [[Overwatch MC-2 Mobile Command Speeder]]s. However a combination of reduced sales after the war and Imperial edicts restricting sales of military-grade vessels led to the class being discontinued. Many ''Starbolt''-class vessels remained in service with system defense navies after the class was discontinued but by the time the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] began they rarely carried the compliment of craft and ground vehicles they had been sold with. [[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenary]] groups and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] bands also salvaged Starbolts for use.<ref name="DC" />
